bayts.text: Hold fast, O Mukhtār, to earnest striving, at every hour, upon the right path.
Cling to the fear of God and seek learning, and do not grin in play, lest you regret it.
Be patient in trial and in austerity (of food), and persevere in calm and in endurance.
If you strive in knowledge in the time of your youth, you shall attain your aims in the time of your old age.
And you shall not gather, my brother, the privileges, until you persevere in patience before misfortunes,
(with) a beautiful patience (Qurʾān 12:18): be not idle; truly the idle one does not lead his generation.
Keep far from all that the Majestic has forbidden, and trust in what the Messenger has brought.
Keep company only with one who guides you aright, and keep far from every companion who would ruin you.
For how many an inexperienced one has become noble through the company of the righteous: do not swerve!
And how many a righteous one has become abject through the company of the fool and the ignorant.
Put your trust in the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān) at all times, O youth of the Daymān.
